include-in-header:
  text: |
    <script>
    // Redirect old Sphinx/Read the Docs URLs to their Quarto equivalents. GitHub Pages
    // serves this page for any missing path, and the fragment (#anchor) is not sent to
    // the server but is still available here, so it can be carried across the redirect.
    (function() {
      var path = window.location.pathname;
      var hash = window.location.hash;

      // Strip the Read the Docs language/version prefix, e.g. /en/latest or /en/v3.2.0
      var rest = path.replace(/^\/en\/[^\/]+/, '');
      if (rest === '' || rest === '/') rest = '/index.html';

      var target = null;
      var match;

      if ((match = rest.match(/^\/api\/_autosummary\/sciris\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.(.+)\.html$/))) {
        target = '/api/' + match[1] + '.html'; // Each object used to have its own page; now they are sections of the module page
        if (!hash) hash = '#sciris.' + match[1] + '.' + match[2];
      } else if ((match = rest.match(/^\/api\/_autosummary\/sciris\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.html$/))) {
        target = '/api/' + match[1] + '.html';
      } else if ((match = rest.match(/^\/_modules\/sciris\/([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.html$/))) {
        target = '/api/' + match[1] + '.html'; // Sphinx source-code pages
      } else if (rest === '/tutorials/' || rest === '/tutorials/index.html') {
        target = '/tutorials.html';
      } else if (rest === '/genindex.html' || rest === '/py-modindex.html' || rest === '/search.html') {
        target = '/api/index.html';
      } else if (rest !== path && /(\.html|\/)$/.test(rest)) {
        target = rest; // Everything else kept its name, and just lost the version prefix
      }

      if (target && target !== path) {
        window.location.replace(target + hash);
      }
    })();
    </script>
